about.title: Building Trust Through Quality, Reliability & Professional Excellence
about.shortDescription: Apurbo Trade International is a Bangladesh-based contractor, supplier and engineering service provider working across construction, procurement, industrial and technical solution areas.
about.description: We are committed to delivering quality products and professional services with integrity, reliability and customer-focused execution. Our business activities cover construction and engineering, procurement and supply, industrial and mechanical solutions, HVAC solutions, fire safety systems and related technical services.

proprietorMessage.name: Mr. Anowar Hossain
proprietorMessage.title: Message from the Proprietor
proprietorMessage.message: It is my pleasure to introduce Apurbo Trade International, a progressive company committed to providing reliable contracting, engineering, procurement and supply solutions. Since our inception, we have remained focused on delivering quality products and professional services that contribute to the success of our valued clients.
proprietorMessage.closing: We look forward to building lasting partnerships through quality, reliability, innovation and excellence.
